comment: E3 — Multi-Realm federation between two nodes. Spec authority: federation/move-anchor-replication.md. Builds on E2 two-node real-spawn, but extends to N realms under one federation pair. Per-Realm anchor isolation is the core invariant: each Realm has its own anchor frontier; replaying Move from server_a → server_b for Realm X must not affect Realm Y's frontier on either side.

encoder.frontier_isolation_rule: anchor frontiers are partitioned by realm_id; cross-Realm operations are forbidden

vectors.name: multi_realm_replay_three_realms_independent_frontiers
vectors.comment: server_a hosts 3 realms (R1, R2, R3). Each ingests one Move. server_b federates pull on each Realm individually. Each replay updates only the target Realm's frontier on server_b; the other two stay empty.

expected.rationale: Per-Realm anchor isolation: each pull updates exactly its target Realm's frontier.

vectors.name: multi_realm_concurrent_move_replay
vectors.comment: Both server_a and server_b host two realms each (R1 + R2). Both ingest Moves into R1 and R2 simultaneously. Bidirectional federation pull/push converges each Realm independently. After convergence, both nodes show the same frontier per Realm, but R1 and R2 frontiers stay distinct.

expected.rationale: After full bidirectional pull, each Realm converges to the same frontier on both nodes. R1 and R2 remain isolated.

vectors.name: multi_realm_cross_realm_move_rejected
vectors.comment: Negative — a Move payload claims to update realm_R1's frontier from a federation push pulled from realm_R2's anchor stream. The peer must reject with cross_realm_move_forbidden.

expected.rationale: Anchor scope must equal the declared realm_id; cross-Realm replay is forbidden.

vectors.name: multi_realm_per_realm_anchor_seq_independent
vectors.comment: Each Realm's anchor sequence number increments independently. After 3 anchors in R1 and 1 in R2, R1.seq=3 and R2.seq=1, NOT a global counter.

expected.rationale: Per-Realm sequence numbers — global ordering would leak cross-Realm activity timing.
